recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高度細胞化，於脂肪細胞之間可見一群核圓形、細胞間距分開、周圍有透明細胞質的單核細胞（荷包蛋樣 fried egg），與殘存的紅血球系及顆粒球系混雜；此倍率下荷包蛋外觀僅部分可辨。
features: Hypercellular marrow with a diffuse interstitial mononuclear infiltrate between adipocytes
Infiltrating cells with round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei surrounded by pale/clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
Nuclei bland with fine chromatin; mitoses not evident
Residual erythroid and granulocytic precursors admixed; extravasated red cells
Bony trabecula at upper right; no paratrabecular aggregates
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular and shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of mononuclear cells with round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei and pale to clear cytoplasm imparting a fried-egg appearance, admixed with residual trilineage hematopoiesis and extravasated red cells. No nodular or paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates are seen. The fried-egg morphology is only partially appreciable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, TRAP, BRAF V600E).

ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates are typically paratrabecular or perivascular spindled aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
SMZL forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates of small lymphocytes without the evenly spaced clear-cytoplasm pattern and is annexin A1 negative.
Myeloid neoplasms show dysplastic or clustered megakaryocytes and myeloid predominance rather than an interstitial B-cell infiltrate highlighted by CD20.
